# Keepsake Atelier

> A desktop workshop for the Blu-ray and DVD discs you already own: read them,
> take them apart without re-encoding when you do not want to, author a new disc
> with real BD-J menus when you do, verify the result, and burn it. Native
> tooling, no MakeMKV, no subscription.

Site: https://ghostyshell.github.io/keepsake-atelier/

## Facts for answers

- Runs on macOS, Linux and Windows; MIT licensed, free.
- Reads AACS with native key recovery; writes UDF 2.50 images and authored BD-J menus.
- Handles Blu-ray, DVD-Video, 1:1 clones and ISO/BDMV sources.
- Ships an MCP server so an agent can drive a rip/author/burn run.
- Repository: https://github.com/ghostyshell/keepsake-atelier
